verdict.rationale: Claude's privacy settings let users toggle whether chats are used to improve the model ('Model Improvement' setting), and incognito chats are explicitly excluded from this even if enabled (claude-docs-46, claude-docs-47), plus Workspace connector data is never used for training (claude-docs-42). This addresses the core 'don't use my data to train models' concern but there's no explicit documentation of a broader telemetry/analytics opt-out (e.g., product usage metrics, crash reporting) separate from model-improvement training data. Missing for 10: explicit mention of general telemetry/analytics tracking controls beyond model-training opt-out, and independent verification that the opt-out is honored in practice.
